descriptions.default: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.
descriptions.auto: A model classifier decides per tool call whether to approve or deny. Hands-off, but safer than Bypass — denials still happen.
descriptions.acceptEdits: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.
descriptions.bypassPermissions: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.
descriptions.plan: Planning mode - no commands are executed

permissionModeDetails.fallback: Controls how the agent asks for approval before using tools.

claude.default: Claude asks before using tools that are not already allowed.
claude.auto: A Claude model reviews each permission request and approves or denies it automatically. Some interactive prompts may also be auto-answered.
claude.acceptEdits: File edits are approved automatically. Other tools still follow Claude's normal permission rules.
claude.bypassPermissions: All permission checks are skipped, so Claude can use tools without asking. Use only in a trusted environment.
claude.plan: Claude can research and build a plan, but cannot edit files or run tools that change the workspace.

cursor.default: Uses Cursor's configured permissions. The separate Skip Permissions setting makes CLIde pass Cursor's Force flag.
cursor.acceptEdits: Currently behaves like Default because CLIde's Cursor adapter does not apply this picker mode.
cursor.bypassPermissions: Currently behaves like Default. Only the separate Skip Permissions setting makes CLIde pass Cursor's Force flag.
cursor.plan: Currently behaves like Default because CLIde's Cursor adapter does not pass Cursor's Plan mode flag.

codex.default: Runs in the workspace sandbox and asks before commands Codex considers untrusted.
codex.acceptEdits: Runs without approval prompts inside the workspace sandbox. Network access and writes outside the workspace stay restricted.
codex.bypassPermissions: Runs without approval prompts or sandbox restrictions, with full system and network access. Use only in a trusted environment.
codex.plan: Uses Codex's Plan collaboration mode with workspace sandboxing and approval prompts.

opencode.default: Uses your OpenCode permission configuration. In non-interactive runs, rules that ask are denied.
opencode.acceptEdits: File edits are allowed automatically. Other tools continue to follow your OpenCode permission configuration.
opencode.bypassPermissions: Enables OpenCode Auto mode: permissions are approved automatically unless your configuration explicitly denies them.
opencode.plan: Uses OpenCode's read-only Plan agent to research and propose an approach without making changes.
